body.objective: Determine whether the covariant Appendix-C squeeze can restore a nonzero finite-regulator order-lambda quadratic Born coefficient after the complete signed BT kernel has zero parent trace, by transporting the same detector projector and trace domain rather than comparing inequivalent bare detectors.
activates: the complete public finite-regulator order-lambda quadratic coefficient
a separation between covariant detector transport and bare Fock occupation
the remaining continuum, dynamical-zero-mode, and higher-order gates
body.current_gate: SQUEEZED_DETECTOR_SIMILARITY: use S^dagger=S^-1 on the paired core and transport the detector, generator, and Born operator together; verify exact trace and projector identities and retain the thermodynamic trace-norm boundary.
body.stop_condition: Certify whether the squeeze changes the completed quadratic coefficient on every finite paired core, while distinguishing that result from a physical continuum coefficient, or certify the first exact domain failure.
body.forbid: no bare b-Fock occupation called an Eq. (19) detector probability; no finite-rank cyclic trace result promoted through the non-trace-class thermodynamic limit; no physical zero, all-order Eq. (19), gravity, BRST, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL promotion
body.resource_hint: Use exact rational matrices and the finite-rank identity (S K S^-1)^dagger(S K S^-1)=S(K^dagger K)S^-1. Recompute the complete signed-kernel parent trace on exact sign/energy fixtures. Contrast covariantly transported projectors with a bare squeezed-vacuum number projection without identifying the latter as Eq. (19). Run sequentially under ulimit -v 500000.
